title: Display plate / a content on a plate
question: What does a pattern become when it is a floor you walk on, or a wall you face?
reference: The common plate of the tiling, patterns, shaders and colour sequences: their content is a material on a quad; the plate is the slot. Walkable glass on the floor (the LED-floor pictures), a screen or poster on a wall.
physical_model: A thin static box the size of the slot (the glass) with the content quad a hair above it inside the rim; stood up for walls; two posts when free-standing.

slot.note: The rim is the frame; the content quad is the slot minus the rim. Sizes 1 to 10 m.
